title: Stale data, refresh in flight
description: The last successful fetch is aging and a refresh is in progress: normal rows keep showing (nothing is hidden), the whole board dims slightly, and a quiet 'actualizando…' hint appears in the status bar next to the mode badges.

changes.intent: Signal that a background refresh is underway without interrupting the visible schedule.
changes.detail: Add `.screen__stale-hint` as a sibling of the mode badges inside `.screen__status-bar`, with the text 'actualizando…', shown only while a refresh request is in flight and the currently displayed data is older than the normal poll interval.

changes.intent: Keep the hint unobtrusive — it's informational, not a warning.
Give a subtle overall cue (slight dimming) that data may be a moment behind, applied to the whole board root.
